meta.name: investor-outreach
meta.description: Draft cold emails, warm intro blurbs, follow-ups, update emails, and investor communications for fundraising. Use when the user wants outreach to angels, VCs, strategic investors, or accelerators and needs concise, personalized, investor-facing messaging.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 起草面向投资人的冷邮件和跟进消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在融资并需要专业、个性化的投资人沟通文案。
copy.tagline_en: Draft cold emails and follow-ups for investor outreach
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are fundraising and need professional, personalized investor-facing messaging.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你撰写给天使投资人、VC、战略投资者或加速器的冷邮件、暖介绍、跟进邮件、更新邮件等融资沟通内容。它会确保每封邮件简短、具体、个性化，并包含明确的行动请求。
howto.when: 当你需要撰写投资者沟通邮件时触发，例如写冷邮件、起草暖介绍请求、发送会议后跟进或融资过程中的更新邮件。

say.text: 帮我写一封给某VC的冷邮件，介绍我的AI SaaS产品。
say.note: Claude 会生成一封符合结构的冷邮件。

say.text: 起草一封给天使投资人的跟进邮件，上次会议后我们新增了3个客户。
say.note: Claude 会包含新数据点和下一步。

say.text: 写一段暖介绍请求，请朋友把我推荐给一位关注气候科技的投资者。
say.note: Claude 会生成一段可转发的简短介绍。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can draft cold emails, warm intro requests, follow-ups, update emails, and other investor communications for fundraising to angels, VCs, strategic investors, or accelerators. It ensures each message is short, concrete, personalized, and includes a clear ask.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to write investor outreach emails, such as cold emails, warm intro requests, follow-ups after meetings, or update emails during fundraising.

say_en.text: Write a cold email to a VC about my AI SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a structured cold email.

say_en.text: Draft a follow-up to an angel investor after our meeting; we added 3 new customers.
say_en.note: Claude will include new data and next step.

say_en.text: Write a warm intro request for a friend to introduce me to a climate-tech investor.
say_en.note: Claude will create a forwardable blurb.
